newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium calls for peaceful transition in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Belgium calls for peaceful transition in Zaire.

text.p: Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko has left the capital Kinshasa, Belgian Foreign Minister Eric Derycke said on Friday, calling for a peaceful transition of power.

"The Minister of Foreign Affairs Eric Derycke, taking note of the fact that President Mobutu has left Kinshasa, expresses the hope that this will contribute to a peaceful solution to the crisis," the foreign ministry said in a statement.
"He launches a fresh appeal to all the parties to avoid a bloodbath," the statement added.
A foreign ministry spokesman said he could only confirm that Mobutu had left the capital and not, as a previous Belgian statement said, the country.
